title: agnus-castus negundo
intro: Agnus-castus negundo, commonly known as Chaste Tree or Vitex negundo, is a plant native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual disorders due to its adaptogenic and anti-anxiety properties. The therapeutic actions of Agnus-castus negundo are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogen-modulating effects. The plant is also used to support hormonal balance and fertility in women, and its bioactive constituents have been studied for their potential in regulating the menstrual cycle and alleviating symptoms of menopause.
